envelope.description: Refresh onto the tools with the deadline signal

body.title: Refresh onto the tools with the deadline signal
body.summary: Move refreshPolicy (ls-remote and fetch or fetch-refs, defaultLocalGit) onto git_ls_remote and git_fetch under one Deadline: each call takes timeoutMs from remainingMs() and the deadline signal, no call starts after the budget is spent, an outer opts.signal is combined, and a denial or cancellation ends the refresh at the first call. The injectable git seam of RefreshOptions receives the Deadline.
acceptanceChecks: refresh-deadline.test.ts: a stand-in git that sleeps makes the refresh fail with the deadline message at 10 seconds, no later call starts, and the running call's process group is gone within 2 seconds
refresh-abort.test.ts: an aborted outer signal ends the refresh at the first aborted call with a cancelled denial
sighting-store.test.ts: the lock-lifetime reasoning still holds

tests.name: refresh-deadline.test.ts: with a stand-in git that sleeps, the refresh fails with the deadline message at 10 s, starts no call after it, and the process group of the running call is gone within 2 s
refresh-abort.test.ts: an aborted outer signal ends the refresh at the first aborted call with a cancelled denial and starts no later call
